info.name: Egypt Nutrition Coach (CuraFit) — Cloudflare Workers API v1
info.description:
Complete, ready-to-use Postman collection for **Egypt Nutrition Coach (CuraFit)** running natively on **Cloudflare Workers + Cloudflare D1** (zero Supabase dependency).

### Quick Start
1. Import this collection AND one of the environments (`Cloudflare_Production` or `Local_Dev`).
2. Run **01. System & Health -> Health Check** to verify connectivity.
3. Run **02. Authentication -> Register** (or **Login**). `accessToken` and `refreshToken` are captured automatically.
4. Run **03. Onboarding -> Generate Initial Plan**. `revision`, `activePlanId`, `activeWorkoutPlanId`, `sampleMealId`, `sampleExerciseId`, and `todayDate` are captured automatically.
5. Run any other request in any folder — `Idempotency-Key` and `revision` are updated automatically on every call!

// Auto-sync revision, serverDate, and ETag across requests

item.name: 01. System & Health
item.description: Public health and runtime capabilities endpoints (no authentication required).

request.description: Public health probe returning API version, engine version, and requestId.

item.name: 02. Authentication (Cloudflare Native D1)
item.description: First-party authentication on Cloudflare Workers + Cloudflare D1 using PBKDF2-SHA256 passwords, HS256 Access JWTs (15 min), and rotating D1 Refresh Tokens (30 days).

request.description: Creates a new user in Cloudflare D1 and returns Access JWT + Refresh Token. Automatically saves tokens and resets revision=0.
Authenticates an existing user and issues a fresh Access JWT + Refresh Token pair.
Exchanges the current refreshToken for a new Access JWT and rotated refreshToken. Replaying an already-rotated refresh token automatically revokes the session.
Returns authenticated userId, sessionId, authMethod, scopes, entitlement tier, and token timestamps.
Verifies currentPassword, updates PBKDF2-SHA256 password hash in D1, and optionally revokes other devices.
Transfers an anonymous Web MVP trial account into the logged-in verified account (requires the owning coach_uid cookie + explicit consent: true).
Revokes a specific sessionId (or allDevices: true) in D1 immediately.
Cleanly logs out the current session (or allDevices: true) and invalidates refresh tokens.

item.name: 03. Onboarding & Pre-Screening
item.description: Clinical eligibility screening, initial nutrition & workout plan generation, and plan lifecycle commands.

request.description: Deterministic pre-onboarding screening for age, BMI, medical conditions, injuries, and maternal status.
Generates the initial 7-day Egyptian/Gulf nutrition plan + adaptive workout plan. Captures activePlanId, activeWorkoutPlanId, sampleMealId, and sampleExerciseId automatically.
Explicit health confirmation for legacy workouts_only accounts that require confirmation before adaptive reviews.
Maps legacy workout day indexes to canonical Sunday=0..Saturday=6 convention.
Generates the next 7-day nutrition week after the current plan expires.

item.name: 12. 90-Day Simulation Mode (?simulation=1)
item.description: Isolated per-user 90-day virtual simulation sandbox (never touches real account data).

request.description: Starts a fresh 90-day simulation round using source: "sample" or "current".
Reads the isolated simulation namespace state and virtual clock.
Fills an empty virtual day with synthetic logs (consistent | plateau | poor_recovery | missed_workout | low_adherence | pain).
Freezes current virtual day summary, advances clock by 1 day (up to day 90), and auto-renews expired nutrition week.

item.name: 13. Privacy, Export & GDPR Deletion
item.description: Consent logging, normalized-table backfill, full JSON data export, and irreversible GDPR account erasure.

request.description: Records versioned explicit user consent in Cloudflare D1.
Backfills historical account logs into normalized D1 tables.
Returns complete machine-readable JSON export of profile, plans, logs, audit trail, and consents.
IRREVERSIBLE: Permanently erases account data, simulation copies, auth credentials, and revokes all tokens.
